articles.title: PSP’s Momei Qu on Anthropic’s Pre-IPO Investor Day
articles.summary: Ahead of Anthropic’s pre-IPO investor day, Momei Qu of PSP Growth says public-market investors may disagree over whether fast-growing AI companies deserve lower margins and heavy capital spending—or must prove stronger returns and profitability. Recent IPO setbacks, including a collapse in Asia and Aura’s withdrawal, illustrate the uncertainty facing both AI firms beyond Anthropic and companies outside the sector. She speaks with Scarlet Fu & Hema Parmar on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Saylor Exclusive, DC Fintech, Longshot Prediction
articles.summary: "Bloomberg Crypto" covers the people, transactions, and technology shaping the world of decentralized finance. Today's guests: Strategy Founder & Executive Chairman Michael Saylor, Vanderbilt Law School Associate Dean Yesha Yadav, and The FinTech Foundation Founder & CEO, Georgetown Law Agnes Williams Sesquicentennial Professor Chris Brummer. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Chip Selloff Rolls On as Big Bank Earnings Begin
articles.summary: A selloff in chipmakers deepened on concerns about the sustainability of the artificial-intelligence trade, putting pressure on equity markets as Wall Street banks kicked off the earnings season. Lori Calvasina, Head of US Equity Strategy at RBC Capital Markets, discusses her S&P outlook and market choppiness. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Revolut and Vinted Backer Sprints Raises €725 Million Fund
articles.summary: Sprints, a venture capital firm that backed Revolut early, has closed its fifth fund of €725 million ($810 million).
articles.author: Yazhou Sun

articles.title: Earnings Season, AI & Oil Prices in Focus
articles.summary: The Close brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are RockCreek CEO & Founder Afsaneh Beschloss, Barclays Multi-Sector Aerospace & Defense Analyst Anthony Valentini, Former Fed Governor Betsy Duke, Robinhood Markets CIO Stephanie Guild, Inflation Insights Founder & President Omair Sharif, Gabelli Funds Portfolio Manager Macrae Skyes, & Neostellar Principal Willy Lee. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Banks Poised to Surprise Wall Street: Analyst
articles.summary: Baird Senior Research Analyst David George joins Bloomberg Open Interest to lay out why he’s bullish on upcoming bank earnings despite a risk‑off market. He explains how AI-driven capital markets may cool, why regional banks could outperform the Wall Street giants, and how post‑election consolidation and higher rates set up JPMorgan and others for upside this quarter. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: T-Mobile Rises on Upgrade; IonQ to Buy Elisity | Stock Movers
articles.summary: On this episode of Stock Movers: - Amazon (AMZN) shares are moving on news it's in negotiations to acquire Decart AI, an artificial intelligence startup, in a deal that could be valued at around $7 billion, the Wall Street Journal reported. The purchase could be wrapped up soon if the negotiations don’t collapse, the Journal said, citing people familiar with the matter. - IonQ (IONQ) shares are moving after it agreed to buy Elisity for as much as $1.3 billion in an all-stock transaction to expand its cybersecurity platform. IonQ Chief Executive Officer Niccolo de Masi said the company will be well positioned to help customers protect critical infrastructure and enterprise networks throughout the transition to the quantum era. - T-Mobile (TMUS) shares are rising after Raymond James upgraded the stock to outperform from market perform, noting that the recent pullback in shares has created a buying opportunity. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Amazon Is in Talks to Buy AI Startup Decart, WSJ Reports
articles.summary: Amazon.com Inc. is in negotiations to acquire Decart AI, an artificial intelligence startup, in a deal that could be valued at around $7 billion, the Wall Street Journal reported.
articles.author: María Paula Mijares Torres

articles.title: OpenAI's $70B Run Rate Meets AI's Infrastructure Challenge
articles.summary: loomberg’s Ed Ludlow breaks down OpenAI's latest annualized revenue, expected to reach or exceed $70 billion by the end of the year. Plus, Oracle keeps several data centers on track by relying on truck deliveries of natural gas, and a conversation with Kleiner Perkins partner Ilya Fushman on the mega AI IPO pipeline and the future of physical AI. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: From Anthropic to Waymo: Kleiner Perkins Bets on AI’s Next Act
articles.summary: Kleiner Perkins partner Ilya Fushman says AI is still in the early stages of reshaping the economy, with opportunities extending from frontier models like Anthropic to consumer agents, autonomous vehicles and robotics. He discusses why the firm sees physical AI as a potential source of the next trillion-dollar companies, the rapid growth of leading private AI businesses, and why he’s increasingly optimistic about both the IPO and M&A markets. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: AI Buildout is Boom 'Not Bubble,' Says Jared Gross
articles.summary: Credit markets are again becoming jittery over the prospects of more mega debt deals hitting a market already flush with financings to pay for the AI arms race. Jared Gross, Head of Institutional Portfolio Strategy at JPMorgan Asset Management, discusses AI asset allocation and why he believes the AI buildout is indeed a boom, not a bubble. (Source: Bloomberg)
